portrait: In this slice, magent functioned as infrastructure architect and debugger, implementing a cloud-based video transcoding system (Coconut.co AV1), fixing operational issues (Blue Railroad bot flip-flopping with hysteresis), and automating IPFS status tracking with Jenkins jobs. The work showed careful attention to data flow and temporal context (Ethereum blockheights), paired with respect for the no-touch server deployment policy. Mistakes were learning moments: assumptions about browser caching and manual server commands were corrected by justin, leading to better practices (reading instead of guessing, using only deployment automation). The session moved from single-purpose IPFS pinning (Pinata-only) toward unified infrastructure visibility (all hosts), with blockheight tracking adding temporal awareness to operations.
